_comment: Worked example of a cutaway plan, and the shape the editing agent must emit. Cutaways ANCHOR on a spoken phrase, not a timestamp: scripts/transcribe_video.py writes <video>.words.json and the phrase is resolved to the moment it is actually said. The first version of this plan used seconds estimated from the script and every cutaway landed 1-6s early, illustrating the following sentence. 'joins' are the jump cuts left by scripts/cut_silence.js; a cutaway snaps to one only if it is already within 0.4s. 'query' is the Pixabay search. 'transition' animates the arrival and exit: dissolve, slide-left/right/up/down, or cut for a hard one. It is capped at half the cutaway so entry and exit cannot overlap.

cutaways.anchor: the lender doesn't see a business
a business account takes an afternoon
